description: Fills a device request block with command code three, a length of 512 bytes, a buffer address and a block offset computed from a block number, then calls a routine to send it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FA6C
name: retry_while_disk_write_protected
description: Repeats a disk request while a status value stays nonzero, showing the message "Disk is write protected, try again." on each retry, and returns once the status clears.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FAA4
name: invoke_single_subroutine
description: Calls one subroutine with no arguments and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FAD0
name: wait_for_game_disk_insert
description: Waits while a device status word reads 29, showing the message "Insert the BattleChess disk." while no disk is present and pausing for 300 units after one appears, until the status returns to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FB4C
name: read_saved_block_from_disk
description: Saves a 13-entry header block, issues a read request on the disk device under the program name "Battle Chess", then restores the header and returns one on success or zero on failure.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FC58
name: read_chess_saves_file
description: Looks up the "ChessSaves" file from a block offset computed from a stored value, issues a read request for the save data, restores the saved header block, and returns one on success or zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FD34
name: restore_saved_header_block
description: Copies a 13-entry saved block from the stack frame back into the shared header area, calls a routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FD36
name: restore_header_and_return_zero
description: Copies the 13-entry saved block from the stack frame back into the shared header area, sets a status word to zero, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FD52
name: restore_header_and_return_one
description: Saves the current status word in the stack frame, copies the 13-entry saved block back into the shared header area, calls a routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FD80
name: issue_disk_command_four
description: Sets the shared request block's command code to four and sends it to the disk device through a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FD9C
name: send_motor_command_if_idle
description: When a stored status word is zero, sets the command code to nine with a zero argument and sends the request to the disk device through a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FDC8
name: set_status_to_minus_one
description: Sets a status word to minus one and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FDE0
name: build_and_send_record_block
description: Clears a 132-byte buffer through a library routine, copies a parameter into its tail, sets two header bytes to eight and twelve, and sends the first 32 bytes through a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FE24
name: wait_for_saves_disk_insert
description: Waits while a disk check fails, showing the message "Insert the ChessSaves disk." on each attempt, and pauses for 300 units once a prompt has been shown and the disk is found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FE4E
name: pause_when_flag_set
description: Pauses for 300 units when a stored 16-bit flag is nonzero, and does nothing otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FE7E
name: clear_shared_status_word
description: Sets a shared status word to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FE8C
name: list_saved_games_directory
description: Reads a 512-byte directory block into a buffer; if that fails it shows the message "No games saved.", otherwise it marks eight save slots and loops over input events to display the saved-game entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FEC2
name: run_load_game_menu
description: Runs the Load menu over eight save slots: it reads the directory block, marks the slots, and loops over input events, redrawing the chosen entry until the menu ends.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FFAA
name: redraw_save_slot_selection
description: Shared loop body that reads the next input event, redraws the selected save-slot entry and reads again, stopping when the event value is nine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FFD0
name: run_save_slot_event_loop
description: Runs the save-slot input loop shared by the save and load menus: it reads events, highlights a slot when the chosen index changes, ends when the event value nine arrives, and then clears the menu flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE4
name: poll_slot_events_until_nine
description: Variant entry into the same save-slot input loop, polling events until the terminating value nine arrives and then clearing the menu flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE6
name: wait_for_save_slot_change
description: Loops over input events while the chosen save slot is unchanged, and highlights the new slot as soon as the selection moves.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10006
name: wait_for_matching_save_slot
description: Loops over input events until the chosen save slot matches the stored slot, then highlights it and clears the menu state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10012
name: handle_save_slot_event_code
description: Handles event code 64 for the save-slot menu: it selects or redraws a slot, ends the menu on value nine, and otherwise reads the next event.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10028
name: clear_save_slot_highlight
description: Highlights the chosen save-slot entry, restores the cursor state, and clears the menu flag on each of eight slot records.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:100CE
name: enter_save_game_name
description: Runs the Save menu's name entry: it reads key events into a 15-character name buffer, handling backspace and return, and on confirmation writes the name into the chosen slot and returns; the text referenced is "Save".

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1018E
name: run_save_name_editor_variant
description: Variant of the save-name entry loop that edits the name field for the chosen slot, handling backspace, return and character input, and returns when the event value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1020A
name: process_save_name_keys
description: Processes one key event for the save-name editor: backspace removes a character, return commits the name to its slot, and printable input appends up to fourteen characters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1023E
name: poll_save_name_editor_events
description: Polls input events for the save-name editor, updating the name field and returning when the event value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10246
name: handle_name_return_or_chars
description: Shared save-name editor fragment: it appends printable characters to the name buffer up to fifteen, handles backspace and return, and reads the next event, ending when the event value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1028C
name: run_name_event_loop_tail
description: Tail of the save-name editor loop: it reads events, handles the return key by committing the name, and clears the editing flags when the loop ends.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1028E
name: redraw_save_name_entry
description: Shared save-name editor loop body: it reads the next input event, updates the name buffer and redraws the entry, and returns when the event value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:102C8
name: continue_save_name_editing
description: Continues the save-name editor from a key event: it appends printable characters, handles backspace and return, and branches back into the event loop, with a cursor character toggled on the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:102F6
name: run_save_name_cursor_loop
description: Save-name editor loop variant that writes a vertical-bar cursor into the name entry, redraws it through a display routine, and reads events until the value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10320
name: clear_save_name_cursor_loop
description: Clears the cursor-visible flag of the save-name editor and runs its event loop, redrawing the name entry until the value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10328
name: select_save_slot_for_name
description: Handles a slot-selection event in the save-name editor: a selected slot is copied into the name buffer and redrawn, and the value nine ends the loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1034E
name: finish_save_name_entry
description: Finishes a name entry by clearing the trailing cursor character, redrawing the slot record with its name, and clearing the highlight.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10390
name: restart_save_name_event_loop
description: Re-enters the save-name event loop, reading events until the value nine arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10394
name: select_slot_and_reset_name
description: Selects the event's save slot, copies its name into the editor, sets the editing flag, and re-enters the event loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:103DE
name: commit_save_name_or_return
description: Ends the name entry: when the name is marked as entered it terminates the buffer, then redraws the slot record and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:103FC
name: load_slot_name_into_editor
description: Copies the selected slot's name into the editor buffer, marks the editor active, and runs the event loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1042C
name: dispatch_save_name_event
description: Dispatches one save-name editor event: code 32 clears the editing flag, code 64 selects a slot, code 2097152 handles backspace and return in the name buffer, and code 4194304 toggles the cursor.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10462
name: write_save_name_and_redraw
description: When a stored name-length word is nonzero it writes the name into the slot record, redraws the slot and clears the buffer; otherwise it reads events and continues the editor loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:104EC
name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine with no arguments and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:104F8
name: copy_text_append_space
description: Clears a buffer through a library routine, copies a text string into it, measures the copied length and appends a space at that position, returning the length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:10540
name: check_printable_character
description: Returns one when the low 16-bit value lies between 32 and 126 inclusive, the printable character range, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1055E
name: pack_active_save_slot_records
description: Clears a 128-byte buffer through a library routine, marks eight rows with end markers, copies each active 48-byte save-slot name into its row with the slot index, and stores the count of active entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1057E
name: pack_active_save_slot_rows
description: Initialises eight 16-byte rows of a packed table with end markers, then copies each active 48-byte save slot into the next row with its slot index and stores the number of rows used.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][v systemz]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][v SystemZ].adf:Battlechess:0:1059A
name: copy_active_slots_to_rows
description: Copies each active 48-byte save-slot record into the next free 16-byte row with its slot index, then stores the number of rows used.
